The '''Supercopa Ecuador''' (''Ecuador Supercup'') is an annual one-match [[association football|football]] official competition in Ecuador organised by the [[Ecuadorian Football Federation]] (FEF) to be played by the champions of the [[Ecuadorian Serie A]] and the [[Copa Ecuador]] of the previous season, starting from 2020. This competition serves as the season curtain-raiser and is scheduled to be played in late January or early February each year, one week before the start of the season.<ref name=Creation>{{cite web|url=http://www.futbolecuador.com/site/noticia/fef-anuncio-la-creacion-de-la-supercopa-ecuatoriana-de-futbol-para-2020/106244|title=Cita separada para los mejores de cada torneo|language=es|publisher=Futbolecuador|date=22 July 2019|access-date=28 January 2020}}</ref>

==History==
With the transfer of organizing rights for the Ecuadorian Serie A and [[Ecuadorian Serie B|Serie B]] from FEF to the [[Liga Profesional de Fútbol del Ecuador|LigaPro]] as well as the creation of the [[Copa Ecuador]] in 2018,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/2018/07/04/nota/6843008/paso-competencias-fef-liga-profesional-futbol-empieza-derechos|title=El paso de competencias de la FEF a la Liga Profesional de Fútbol empieza con los derechos comerciales|language=es|publisher=El Universo|date=4 July 2018|access-date=26 December 2018}}</ref> on 4 July 2019 the FEF decided to approve the creation of a supercup competition to be played by the champions of both the Serie A and the Copa Ecuador a week prior to the start of each league season, starting from 2020.<ref name=Creation/> On 31 October 2019, the first Supercopa Ecuador edition was confirmed to be played by the [[2019 Ecuadorian Serie A|league]] and [[2019 Copa Ecuador|cup]] champions of the 2019 season, taking place on 1 February 2020 at a neutral ground.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/2019/10/31/nota/7584263/fef-anuncia-realizacion-supercopa-ecuador-partir-2020|title=FEF anuncia la realización de la Supercopa Ecuador a partir del 2020|language=es|publisher=El Universo|date=31 October 2019|access-date=28 January 2020}}</ref>

For its [[2021 Supercopa Ecuador|2021]] edition and given that the 2020 [[Copa Ecuador]] was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador|COVID-19 pandemic]], the FEF announced an expansion of the tournament to four teams, which would play in two single-leg semi-final matches and a final between the semi-final winners in the cities of [[Guayaquil]] and [[Quito]]. In addition to the most recent Serie A and Supercopa Ecuador champions, [[C.S.D. Independiente del Valle|Independiente del Valle]] and [[C.S. Emelec|Emelec]] were invited to play that edition of the competition on account of their recent achievements.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ecuagol.com/ecuagol/?n=165728|title=FEF anunció nuevo formato de la Supercopa Ecuador con 4 equipos|language=es|publisher=Ecuagol|date=8 January 2021|access-date=15 January 2021}}</ref> The 2021 edition was later expanded to six teams, with two teams getting a bye to the semi-finals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://studiofutbol.com.ec/2021/06/05/asi-sera-el-formato-de-la-supercopa-ecuador-2021/|title=¡Así será el formato de la Supercopa Ecuador 2021!|language=Spanish|publisher=Studio Fútbol|date=5 June 2021|access-date=14 June 2021}}</ref> The competition reverted to its original format for its following edition in [[2023 Supercopa Ecuador|2023]], since the Copa Ecuador was played in the previous year.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eltelegrafo.com.ec/noticias/fanatico/1/aucas-independiente-valle-copa|title=Aucas e Independiente del Valle disputarán la Supercopa Ecuador 2023 |trans-title=Aucas and Independiente del Valle will play the 2023 Supercopa Ecuador |language=es |publisher=El Telégrafo |date=11 January 2023 |access-date=18 January 2023}}</ref>

==Participating clubs==
The Supercopa Ecuador is played between:
* The Serie A champions
* The Copa Ecuador champions

In the event the same club wins both the league and the domestic cup, its rival in the Supercopa will be the Copa Ecuador runner-up.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.elcomercio.com/deportes/supercopa-campeones-ligapro-copa-ecuador.html|title=La Supercopa se jugará en enero del 2020 entre los campeones de la LigaPro y la Copa Ecuador|language=es|publisher=El Comercio|date=10 July 2019|access-date=28 January 2020}}</ref>

==Competition format==
*One 90-minute game at a neutral venue
*If tied, a [[Penalty shootout (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] decides the winner
